brouwer_airsoft: After 9 days of war, Q-F14 had a place for everything. On Day 9, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Rafael "Lucky" Airsoft.
c10ud_b3rry3.0: Edmund "Smokes" Rry stepped off the supply cart at S-F9 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.
One of the first hundred, Edmund "Smokes" Rry was given the First Wave ribbon. He wrapped the accompanying paper against the damp.

Edmund "Smokes" Rry dreamt of missing a train. Waking up here seemed an unreasonable punishment for it. Word came down the line: Verdel Ridge is ours. Edmund "Smokes" Rry shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
The gun team argued about who carried the heaviest load. Edmund "Smokes" Rry offered to swap loads. The argument ended at once.
Edmund "Smokes" Rry fired at a movement across the wire at S-F9. The man went down: Emil Galvanooooo, grazed.

At Lantern Hill, Edmund "Smokes" Rry and Leopold Fwtx exchanged rifle shots until a shell burst between the positions. For a while, both rifles remained silent. The Hegemony hold Hill 304 now, and they can see straight into S-F9. Edmund "Smokes" Rry has learned to walk bent double.
The men argued about whether fish sleep. Edmund "Smokes" Rry said yes, and was told to explain how anyone could know.
Edmund "Smokes" Rry taught Nils Zczc to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop.

Edmund "Smokes" Rry was hit through the stomach at S-F9. The bearers ran with the stretcher and did not stop to rest. Shot by Gideon Jimmysparrow of the Hegemony (@jimmysparrow17). Edmund "Smokes" Rry was killed outright at S-F9, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Gideon Jimmysparrow of the Hegemony (@jimmysparrow17).

Roland Rry asked about Edmund "Smokes" Rry on arriving at S-F9. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another. Number 84 on the early rolls: Roland Rry. The First Wave ribbon arrived with instructions about where to sew it and no needle.
Roland Rry fixed the bayonet, then thought better of it and fired instead. Across the wire, Arno Toastyy was grazed.
daami_nt: After 9 days of war, R-C8 had a place for everything. On Day 9, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Konrad Daami.
eurotrashhhhhh: The old hands of S-S14 have been here since Day 1. Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh has been here since Day 7. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.

Two carrying parties met in the narrow trench. Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh helped work out how an ammunition box and a very large kettle could pass each other. A letter from home reached Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh before dusk. Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh read it twice and slept a little easier. Now serving as a signaller, Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh discovered that being experienced at the front did not prevent being new at the job.

Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh was promised a surprise at supper. It was an extra potato. He accepted the surprise with proper ceremony. A letter from home reached Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh before dusk. Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh read it twice and slept a little easier.
hellcat34106: They issued Tobias Hellcat a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a dented harmonica in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.

Tobias Hellcat fired at a movement across the wire at S-F15. The man went down: Benedikt Jakubwilkuu, grazed. Verdel Ridge is in Concord hands. Tobias Hellcat stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Tobias Hellcat borrowed a magnifying glass to read cramped handwriting. The urgently needed word turned out to be 'cabbage'.

Teodor "Brick" Vuminhtri of the Concord spotted Tobias Hellcat of the Hegemony repairing a parapet at Calvary Farm. A warning shot stopped the repair on the spot. A letter from home reached Tobias Hellcat before dusk. Tobias Hellcat read it twice and slept a little easier.

Tobias Hellcat went out with the wiring party at S-F15. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit. A letter from home reached Tobias Hellcat before dusk. Tobias Hellcat read it twice and slept a little easier. Tobias Hellcat walked the captured trenches of Hill 304 and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

A clear shot from S-F15. Tobias Hellcat grazed Jakub "Ash" Cocac and slid back down below the parapet. Tobias Hellcat raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-F15. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Bram Archiegregor of the Concord (@archiegregorysmith). A letter from home reached Tobias Hellcat before dusk. Tobias Hellcat read it twice and slept a little easier.
Tobias Hellcat's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it. A letter from home reached Tobias Hellcat before dusk. Tobias Hellcat read it twice and slept a little easier.

A round went through Tobias Hellcat's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Clement "Hollow" Killerdogman of the Concord (@killerdogman2010). A letter from home reached Tobias Hellcat before dusk. Tobias Hellcat read it twice and slept a little easier.

A round came through the loophole Tobias Hellcat was watching at S-F15 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Edmund Callmequeeno of the Concord (@callmequeenorea_). Tobias Hellcat looked over the parapet at S-F15 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Edmund Callmequeeno of the Concord (@callmequeenorea_).
Nils Hellcat had heard about Tobias Hellcat's courage. At S-F15, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
kracun.e: Nobody saw Norbert Kracun arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in S-C6, and a quiet rifleman under it.
landon59504: By the time Felix Landon reached R-F17, the war was 2 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down. Verdel Ridge is in Concord hands. Felix Landon watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Felix Landon raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F17. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Jakub "Brick" Ingfan of the Hegemony (@seal.ingfan).
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Felix Landon is whole again, or near enough for the line.

Felix Landon spent an hour repairing a pocket. Nothing goes in it now without a careful inspection. From Hill 304 the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Felix Landon wrote to a teacher who said he would amount to nothing that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
The company barber offered a choice of haircuts. Felix Landon asked to see the second one. The barber laughed.
A letter reached Felix Landon from Dunmarrow. The streets there still have names. He read them out loud, one by one.
Felix Landon dreamt about missing a train. Waking up here felt like a harsh punishment for it.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Felix Landon's ear at R-F17 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Jakub "Brick" Ingfan of the Hegemony (@seal.ingfan).
malakaicripps: Walter "Hollow" Malakaicripp stepped off the supply cart at R-F7 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name. Walter "Hollow" Malakaicripp asked to leave the stretcher bearers and serve as a sniper. The sergeant looked at him for a long time, then signed the paper without a word. Day 3. Verdel Ridge fell to the Concord. Walter "Hollow" Malakaicripp watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
A flare caught Walter "Hollow" Malakaicripp halfway through a yawn on the fire step. He stayed still until his jaw ached.
The company barber offered a choice of haircuts. Walter "Hollow" Malakaicripp asked to see the second one. The barber laughed.

Walter "Hollow" Malakaicripp fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Rafael "Owl" Franz, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Hill 304. Walter "Hollow" Malakaicripp folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Walter "Hollow" Malakaicripp saw Benedikt Ngaihte freeze up on the fire step at the Sunken Road. Hollow said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough.
A clear shot from R-F7. Walter "Hollow" Malakaicripp grazed Albin "Tin" Shoes and slid back down below the parapet.

Walter "Hollow" Malakaicripp smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Bram "Hollow" Localfilipin came out for a cup and was badly wounded. Walter "Hollow" Malakaicripp raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F7. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Norbert Sharky of the Concord (@just_sharky24).
The medic cut the last bandage off Walter "Hollow" Malakaicripp's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to R-F7 the same hour.
zander.joseph2006: Leopold Joseph arrived with the Day 7 draft, carrying his brother's pocket watch and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.
Leopold Joseph carried Konrad Cbour's rifle all the way up to the Hanging Bridge after Konrad twisted an ankle. Neither has said thank you. Neither needs to.
The cook's fire went out. Leopold Joseph relit it under his own coat and served stew that tasted of wool.
